journal.non_effects: Pure metadata name/profile construction, item validation, software translation and preflight reads. Read failure after prior history explicitly quarantines with original error; no fake success ticket.
journal.ordering: Begin returns a real pending ticket before expression evaluation. Every effect callback verifies it. Result recorded exactly once afterward; zero only REPORTED_SUCCESS, all nonzero original errors REPORTED_FAILURE. Lost-result injection records UNKNOWN with nonzero marker-970.
journal.retention: Even successful/no-op history permanently prevents bpl_retire_private. Logical ring/IRQ close does not change canonical lease. Failed/unknown operations quarantine and retain requester/vector/all backing; duplicates remain conflicting.
journal.partial_submit: Fake index applied after buffer copy; PHY reset before readback/bell. Core records failure; dirty/inflight/fault retained, ring index_published0 (no readback-confirmed publication), actual fake WI1, no bell. No hidden retry.
journal.consumer_scope: One explicitly journaled CPU store in the fake RI file advances synthetic consumer. Not firmware/DMA/proof of device completion. Counter separate from raw callback write-attempt count.
journal.private_prefix: Initial preflight failure before any ticket can retire known private metadata only. All static pages remain live; no actual storage free.
